Video title: Kegareboshi Blue
Release Date: December 26, 2025

Description:
Ibuki and Kokoharu are a new idol duo called "Stellarista" who aim to become top idols.
Ibuki and her manager Matsunami are celebrating the success of their live performance, but...
When she finds out about Kokoharu and Matsunami's scandal, she storms out to the weekly magazine, only to find that the drink they offer her is drugged...
Producer Kurozuka, who has set up a trap for her, has the evil hand of sending Ibuki plummeting into a whirlpool of ecstasy...!
